##### Project general facts

Art Bay is a distinctive residential development in Al Jaddaf, created through the collaboration between Dutco and Ellington. The project reflects a refined architectural vision that blends modern design with artistic inspiration, creating a unique living environment rooted in creativity and culture. With spacious layouts and clean, minimalist aesthetics, the development is designed to offer a balanced lifestyle where contemporary elegance meets a strong connection to art and surrounding cultural landmarks.

The development offers a thoughtfully curated selection of amenities that support family living, creativity, and everyday comfort. Residents benefit from well-designed communal spaces and lifestyle facilities that encourage relaxation and social interaction, all within a vibrant cultural setting surrounded by galleries and museums. The project is tailored for those who appreciate a dynamic yet refined environment, combining urban convenience with a creative atmosphere.

The interiors are finished with high-quality materials, featuring porcelain tiled flooring, floor-to-ceiling windows, and a soft, minimalist palette that enhances natural light and openness. The kitchens are fully equipped, designed with spacious layouts that combine functionality with a modern aesthetic. The units are delivered unfurnished, allowing residents the flexibility to personalize their homes and create spaces that reflect their own style and vision.

##### Location description and benefits

Al Jaddaf, situated in Dubai, United Arab Emirates, is a dynamic and culturally rich district that seamlessly integrates elements of culture, commerce, and leisure. This area holds cultural significance, boasting a plethora of museums, art galleries, and cultural centers that pay tribute to local and international heritage. Among these, the Dubai Culture Village stands out as a vibrant hub for artistic expression and creative exploration.

With its picturesque location along the Dubai Creek, Al Jaddaf offers stunning waterfront views. It has witnessed significant development, welcoming luxury hotels and contemporary residential complexes that provide captivating vistas of the Dubai Creek.

Al Jaddaf also caters to leisure and recreation, with well-maintained parks and open spaces for residents and visitors to enjoy outdoor activities. The presence of diverse restaurants and cafes adds to its charm, making it a delightful destination for relaxation and dining.
